ACETATE.gloss: a salt or ester of acetic acid
ACETATE.definition: A salt or ester of acetic acid.

TACT.gloss: consideration in dealing with others and avoiding giving offense
TACT.definition: Consideration in dealing with others and avoiding giving offense.

ACT.gloss: perform an action, or work out or perform
ACT.definition: Perform an action, or work out or perform (an action).

CAT.gloss: feline mammal usually having thick soft fur and no ability to roar
CAT.definition: Feline mammal usually having thick soft fur and no ability to roar: domestic cats; wildcats.

TEA.gloss: a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water
TEA.definition: A beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water.
TEA.example: Iced tea is a cooling drink.

ACE.gloss: the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number
ACE.definition: The smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number.
ACE.example: He has the one but will need a two and three to go with it.

TEE.gloss: the starting place for each hole on a golf course
TEE.definition: The starting place for each hole on a golf course.
TEE.example: They were waiting on the first tee.
